DPPOv26.pdf.applicability: Last day of legal filing deadline after 2026-12-31; future replacements take precedence
DPPOv26.pdf.rights: Official Ministry of Finance form intended for taxpayer completion. Original notice, credits and legal status retained; the background is not relicensed as module code.

table_d_instructions.scope: Entered loss eligibility and following-tax-period ordinal; validated deduction, current micro status, balances and native row410. Current-period losses are first reported in row400, not Table D. No automatic qualification of special incentive regimes. Later legal/form changes require the ordinary publication refresh.

table_i_instructions.scope: Transactions 01-37; loans 01-05; at most 99 rows in each section; signed transaction effect includes timing effects and is not the sum of row 400. Additional rows use clearly marked continuation copies of the original Table I pattern.

table_ek_instructions.scope: Typed reviewed treaty/net-income/paid-or-estimated foreign-tax facts feed native row710; country breakdown in IX and separate section31 currency-conversion annex. Paid original minimum-tax differences, prior/current credits and reviewed following-tax-period ordinal feed native row920. K retains evidence even when current credit is zero. No inferred foreign tax or automatic treaty/legal eligibility; ordinary accountant retains source evidence. Three subsequent tax periods include short periods.

table_fl_instructions.scope: Ordinary double-entry accounting; F is existing posted revenue/cost before income tax, or explicitly reviewed imported source figures. Signed entered L adjustments feed native row560. Row1110 uses r500*rate550/100-r610, with an evidenced historic section35/35a blank-field exception.

DPPOv26.pdf.table_l_layout_note: The published pattern has 26 physical adjustment slots numbered 2..21,23..28. The original page is preserved; marked continuation copies supply missing22 then29..98, without omitting any entered fact.
